library.name: React
library.description: React is compiled from source (js/src) into the prebuilt authoring editor bundle js/vendor/react/editor.bundle.js, for Moodle versions without native React runtime support (4.5 to 5.1). This declaration points at the js/vendor/react directory (which documents the bundle) rather than at a build artefact under amd/build/, so Moodle's Grunt and moodle-plugin-ci do not fail: moodle-plugin-ci wipes amd/build/ before re-running Grunt and would flag a bundle Grunt cannot regenerate. See js/vendor/react/README.md.

library.name: ReactDOM
library.description: ReactDOM is bundled into the prebuilt authoring editor AMD module together with React (see the React entry for build details).

library.name: Scheduler
library.description: Scheduler (a ReactDOM runtime dependency) is bundled into the prebuilt authoring editor AMD module together with React and ReactDOM.
